svg.metadata: Brunei national map: existing mainland/Temburong geometry from GSHHS/GSHHG intermediate coastline and Basemap political boundary data, WGS84; Pulau Muara Besar coastline added from OpenStreetMap way 28531951 version 9, 2025-03-01, ODbL 1.0, current source captured 2026-09-23 (raw SHA-256 dd1bb1fbab630eb793b2c855f678fbc5a01f5ff21c1bdfdaf1410577669993d3). Canvas 1200x760; bounds W113.95 E115.45 S3.95 N5.15. Surrounding Sarawak context and national-border linework are rendered beneath the protected Brunei land. Shared Country template renders Hero and scene markers. https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
